_comment: Happy Health lakehouse layout. One set per environment (dev, uat, prod); names are identical across environments so deployment pipelines only change the workspace.

lh_bronze.purpose: Raw source data exactly as received (FHIR NDJSON, HL7v2 files, mirrored tables)
lh_bronze.label: Highly Confidential - PHI

lh_silver.purpose: FHIR-shaped, cleaned, coded clinical tables (Healthcare Data Solutions + Happy Health tables)
lh_silver.label: Highly Confidential - PHI

lh_silver_identity.purpose: Patient matching outputs: dimPatientSource, dimPerson, bridgePatientLinkHistory, linkVersion, review queue
lh_silver_identity.label: Highly Confidential - PHI

lh_mdm.purpose: Settings exported from Profisee: matching thresholds and weights, measure parameters, provider and location masters
lh_mdm.label: Confidential

lh_gold_quality.purpose: Quality star schema, calculation runs, measure results
lh_gold_quality.writeMode: rebuild facts; append runs (frozen once submitted)
lh_gold_quality.label: Highly Confidential - PHI

lh_gold_pophealth.purpose: Patient 360 mart for the ACO (after day 120)
lh_gold_pophealth.label: Highly Confidential - PHI

lh_monitoring.purpose: notebookRunLog, notebookErrorLog, conversionErrorLog; source for the audit model
lh_monitoring.label: Confidential

deltaMaintenance.notes: Bronze is never vacuumed below its retention period

uat.note: raise to F64 for the parallel run (weeks 9-11)

pipelineDefaults.onFailure: Teams alert to the data on-call channel
